name: Keynote
pitch: A big-room launch talk where one idea at a time lands on a dark stage, lit from above.

illustration.medium: flat vector on near-black, cinematic product-launch illustration with soft glow
illustration.line: 1px hairline strokes, thin and precise, almost invisible against the dark
illustration.shapes: simple geometric forms (circles, thin rings, subtle grids), generous negative space
illustration.texture: soft radial glow behind key shapes, otherwise flat
illustration.palette_use: near-black background dominant, soft sky-blue accent used as a glowing highlight, muted grey-blue for secondary detail
illustration.avoid: clutter, bright multi-color palettes, hand-drawn line, hard black outlines
